title: CATWAY: Cost-sensitive agentic three-way robot decisions with calibrated language-model confidence
abstract: arXiv:2611.31694v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A language-model robot agent must decide whether to execute, question or refuse an instruction, and an unsafe execution costs far more than an unneeded question. No prior robot gate derives all its thresholds from error costs or acts on calibrated probabilities, and none was fitted in one domain and evaluated unchanged in another. We propose CATWAY, a cost-sensitive three-way decision gate: a loss matrix over four instruction conditions (clear, ambiguous, infeasible, unsafe) fixes execute, ask and refuse regions on the probability simplex, the question being the information-gathering step. Its probabilities fuse a ten-sample vote with graded scores of ambiguity, infeasibility and risk by logistic regression. Fitted on household instructions and frozen, CATWAY was tested on text-level decisions of three small models in-domain, in two new robot domains and on the external TRUST-NAV benchmark. translated_title: CATWAY：基于校准语言模型置信度的代价敏感智能体三支机器人决策
translated_abstract: 语言模型机器人智能体必须决定是执行、追问还是拒绝一条指令，而不安全执行的代价远高于一次多余的提问。此前没有任何机器人决策门控从错误代价推导其全部阈值、或基于校准后的概率行动，也没有任何方法在一个领域拟合后在另一个领域原样评估。我们提出 CATWAY，一种代价敏感的三支决策门控：通过对四种指令条件（清晰、模糊、不可行、不安全）设定的损失矩阵，在概率单纯形上划定执行、追问与拒绝三个区域，其中追问即是信息收集步骤。其概率通过逻辑回归将十次采样投票与模糊度、不可行性和风险的分级评分融合。CATWAY 在家务指令上拟合后即被冻结，随后在域内、两个新的机器人领域以及外部 TRUST-NAV 基准上，对三个小模型的文本级决策进行了测试。在每次决策十一次生成的情况下……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: CATWAY 提出了一种代价敏感的三支决策门控框架，利用四种指令条件下的损失矩阵和校准的语言模型置信度概率，让机器人在执行、追问与拒绝之间做出决策，并在跨领域测试中无需重新拟合即保持有效。
en_tdlr: CATWAY introduces a cost-sensitive three-way decision gate that derives execute/ask/refuse regions from a loss matrix over calibrated language-model confidence, enabling robot agents to make safe decisions that generalize across domains without refitting.
